maddeler.e:
تعاظمت (form VI)
# تَعَاظَمْتُ (taʕāẓamtu) /ta.ʕaː.ðˤam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
# تَعَاظَمْتَ (taʕāẓamta) /ta.ʕaː.ðˤam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
# تَعَاظَمْتِ (taʕāẓamti) /ta.ʕaː.ðˤam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
# تَعَاظَمَتْ (taʕāẓamat) /ta.ʕaː.ðˤa.mat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
